preconditions.description: The length of word t is greater than the length of word p.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= len(t) for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each index in the permutation a is within the bounds of the length of word t.
All indices in the permutation a are distinct.

postconditions.description: The number of letters Nastya can remove is between 0 and the difference in lengths of t and p.

postconditions.expression: all(t[i] == p[j] for j, i in enumerate(indices) if i is not None)
postconditions.description: The remaining letters in t after Nastya's removals form the word p, where indices are the positions of letters in t that match p.
